Application Materials.content:
- An updated Resume
- Your official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended.
- 2 Personal Statements:
1. Explain in 500-600 words your career and personal aspirations, and your motivation for pursuing the Master of Business Administration Programme.
2. Discuss in 500-600 words one of the following topics:
- Describe your greatest weakness and how you have tried to overcome it.
- Describe your outstanding talents, skills and inherent abilities that are not reflected in your academic qualifications and records.
- Describe the situation with the greatest ethical complexity that you have faced in your professional or academic life, and how your input helped resolve it.
- 2 Referee Reports - Submit 2 complete sets of referee details during the online process of applying for the SMU MBA. The application portal will automatically send an email to your referees and collect your recommendation forms on your behalf once you have submitted the application.
- Copy of NRIC/FIN/Passport (in PDF or JPEG format)
- Any other supporting documents
Supporting documents needed:
01. A copy of NRIC for SingaporeanCitizen; or a copy of Passport for non-Singaporeans
02. A copy of NRIC, Passport and re-entry permit for Singaporean Permanent Residents
03. 2 passport-size photographs
04. Official GMAT/GRE score report (school version)
05. 2 short essays
06. Current CV
07. Official academic transcripts of all educational institutions attended
08. Contact details of 2 referees
10. Any other supporting documents
Reapplicants should send the MBA office one reapplicant essay and one additional letter of recommendation. Required reapplicant essay: Please describe your career progress since you last applied and ways in which you have enhanced your candidacy (500 words). SMU keeps applications on file for 2 years, so individuals who reapply within this time period do not need to resubmit transcripts or standardized test scores (GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS, et cetera) unless there has been a change to these components.

Interview Requirements.content:
You will be informed if you are selected for an interview within two weeks of your online application. If you are not based within Singapore, the interview will be conducted by phone or webcam. Otherwise, it will be a face-to-face interview on campus. After being shortlisted for the interview, please send via courier/bring along:
- Original degree scrolls and transcripts (for those who have applied online)

Academic Requirements.content:
- **Bachelor's Degree** / individuals must hold a **university degree** to apply.
- Applicants should have a **good undergraduate degree from a reputable institution (in any field)** and demonstrate strong academic credentials, as evidenced by past academic performance.
- **Minimum post-degree work experience of 2 years** / minimum of **2 years' full-time working experience** is required. The programme has a strict minimum work experience requirement of **2 years**, and participants have an average of 5 to 6 years of working experience.
- Applicants do **not** need to come from a finance or business background: “we admit students from all backgrounds and work experience.”
- **Successful completion of 5 pre-study assessments covering 3 modules is mandatory for programme enrolment**; students are required to pass these before the start of the term.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- Pre-requisites include **GMAT / GRE / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT)**. *SMUAT applicable only for eligible candidates.
- The GMAT/GRE is the basis for comparison of applicants from diverse national, educational and professional backgrounds. While the SMU MBA programme has **no minimum GMAT/GRE score**, candidates who register higher than average scores in the verbal, quantitative and writing sections will be considered to be more competitive.
- Required application item: “A good GMAT ([try a GMAT mini quiz](https://www.mba.com/gmat-mini-quiz?utm_campaign=Global_All_Mini-Quiz_11Apr2016&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=smu)) / GRE ([try a GRE mini quiz](https://www.ets.org/gre/gre-mini-quiz.html)) / *SMU Admissions Test (SMUAT) score (click [here](https://postgraduate.smu.edu.sg/acton/attachment/11522/f-4aba8d35-81c0-41d8-860f-8aa1c29d5d03/1/-/-/-/-/SMU%20Admissions%20Test%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf) to view the SMUAT Factsheet).”
- **SMU graduates with cumulative GPAs of 3.0/4.0 or better**, and **graduates from local Autonomous Universities (NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, SIT) with cumulative GPAs of 3.5/5.0 or better** will not require a GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test score for admissions. An undergraduate GPA is valid for **5 years after graduation**. Please note that meeting the above GPA academic criteria does not guarantee admission. Candidates may still be advised to submit GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test scores to further strengthen their application.
- If you have not taken the GMAT/GRE, you are encouraged to take the SMU Admissions Test. Alternatively, you may first submit your online application and arrange for the GMAT/GRE test to be taken as soon as possible. Do include the date of your test as well.
- FAQ: “An admissions test (GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test) is also a compulsory requirement for admission.” An admissions test (GMAT/GRE/SMU Admissions Test) is required for all candidates (regardless of age) for both the Part-time and Full-time programmes.
- You can send your application prior to taking the GMAT/GRE. However, admissions decisions will not be made until the GMAT/GRE score is received.
- Required supporting document: **Official GMAT/GRE score report (school version)**.
- SMU's GMAT institution codes are: **Full-Time MBA: F8D-7V-17**; **Part-Time MBA: F8D-7V-35**. SMU's GRE institution code is: **Full-Time / Part-Time MBA: 2861**.
- SMU does not set a limit to the number of times you sit for the GMAT/GRE. Applicants should report all past scores and SMU will consider the highest score achieved for application evaluation.

English Proficiency Requirements.content: The TOEFL/IELTS is only required if your undergraduate education or postgraduate education was not taught in English.

Program Overview.content:
The SMU Master of Business Administration (MBA) is designed to shape students into versatile and dynamic leaders through an interactive and rigorous curriculum that captures the forefront of management research and proven approaches in management practice.
Designed for flexibility, the MBA programme is available in both full-time and part-time modes of study:
- Full-time: 15 months, with the flexibility to complete within 10 months. The full-time programme spreads over 12-15 months with an option to complete an internship; students engage in pre-term self-study before commencement. Core classes take place Monday to Thursday in the morning or afternoon, and elective classes take place Monday to Thursday, 7pm to 10.45pm, and Saturday. Fridays are catered for make-up classes, career opportunities and leadership development. Students can opt to do an internship, go for overseas exchange, or take an SMU-XO elective.
- Part-time: 20 months, with the flexibility to complete within 15 months. The part-time programme is designed for working professionals over a span of 18-20 months; students engage in pre-term self-study before commencement. Core classes take place on Monday and Tuesday evenings, and elective classes take place Monday to Thursday, 7pm to 10.45pm, and Saturday. Part-time and full-time students attend elective classes together.
The programme structure includes pre-study modules, 8 core modules, 10 elective modules with choice of tracks, and career development. Full-time students may complete an internship or New Venture Creation project; part-time students may take the Management Study Module or Overseas Exchange. Successful completion of 5 pre-study assessments covering 3 modules is mandatory for programme enrolment. The duration of each class is 3 hours and 45 minutes.
The SMU MBA offers optional specialisations in Communications, Entrepreneurship, Finance, or Human Capital. It also equips students with knowledge of Data Science, including Basic R and Python Programming, and includes core learning in “Leading Digital Transformation” and “Business Analytics.” ESG content is woven into all MBA core courses, and all MBA students are required to attend a compulsory 1-day Sustainability workshop.
The programme offers real-world experience through internship opportunities for full-time students via SMU’s network of 3,000 companies worldwide. Exchange partners include Keio University in Japan, Seoul National University in South Korea, Peking University in China, IE in Spain, and University of British Columbia in Canada. Full-time students also have the opportunity to take part in the Overseas Immersion Programme, where students learn about operating and leading organisations in the Asian context.
The SMU MBA was ranked 10th among universities in Asia and 51st worldwide in the Financial Times Global MBA Ranking 2022. 80% of graduates are employed within 6 months, often in positions of leadership, and the programme provides networking and career opportunities supported by dedicated career counsellors.
Class profile data from the Classes of 2018-2021 (Full-time & Part-time): gender ratio 3:2, average age 30, international students 63%, 26 nationalities, and average years of working experience 5.9.
Industries MBA graduates work in, based on Classes of 2018-2020 (Full-time & Part-time): Business / Financial Services 22%, Technology 20%, Consulting 16%, Healthcare 12%, Manufacturing 6%, Real Estate 4%, Transportation / Logistics 3%, and Others 17%.
The programme is taught by internationally renowned and experienced SMU faculty and industry professionals. The part-time and full-time MBA both require physical attendance, though some modules use web and online updates to supplement time in class.
SMU’s dedicated career services team actively helps students prepare for internships. The career services also provide self-assessment guides and career coaching to improve participants’ overall job performance and long-term career goals. Companies that have hired MBA graduates include Julius Baer, Yahoo, Unilever, Givaudan, Keppel, HSBC, PriceWaterhouseCoopers, ExxonMobil and Bain.

Curriculum.content:
Designed for flexibility, the MBA programme is available in both full-time (**15 months, with the flexibility to complete within 10 months**) and part-time (**20 months, with the flexibility to complete within 15 months**) modes of study.
- **Full-time Programme:** spreads over **12-15 months** with an option to complete an internship. Students are engaged in pre-term self-study before commencement. Students have the option to complete the full-time SMU MBA in **10 months** when all the credit requirements have been fulfilled.
- Core classes (Terms 1 and 2) take place from Monday to Thursday, either in the morning or afternoon.
- Elective classes (Terms 3 to 5) take place from Monday to Thursday (**7pm to 10.45 pm**) and Saturday. Part-time and Full-time Programme students attend these classes together.
- Fridays are catered for make-up classes, career opportunities and leadership development.
- The duration of each class is **3 hours 45 minutes**.
- Students can opt to do an internship, go for overseas exchange, or take an SMU-XO elective (TBC).
- **Part-time Programme:** designed for working professionals over a span of **18-20 months**. Students are engaged in pre-term self-study before commencement. Students have the option to complete the full-time SMU MBA in **15 months** when all the credit requirements have been fulfilled.
- Core classes (Terms 1 to 4) take place on Monday and Tuesday evenings.
- Elective classes (Terms 5 to 7) take place from Monday to Thursday (**7pm to 10.45pm**) and Saturday. Part-time and Full-time Programme students attend these classes together.
- The duration of each class is **3 hours and 45 minutes**.
The programme calendar includes **Pre-Study Modules**, **8 Core Modules** plus Career Development, and **10 Elective Modules** with choice of tracks. For Full-time students, it is optional to complete either the Internship or New Venture Creation project. For Part-time students, it is optional to take the Management Study Module or Overseas Exchange. Successful completion of **5 pre-study assessments covering 3 modules** is mandatory for programme enrolment.
**8 Core Modules**
- Corporate Finance
- Financial Accounting
- Leading Digital Transformation
- Business Analytics
- Marketing
- Operations Management
- Organisational Behaviour and Leadership
- Strategic Management
ESG content is woven into all MBA core courses. In addition, all MBA students are required to attend a compulsory **1-day Sustainability workshop**.
**Up to 14 Elective Modules**
| Track-specific Elective Modules | Modules offered |
| --- | --- |
| Finance Track | Entrepreneurial Finance; Financial Analytics and Innovation; Hedge Funds; Merge and Acquisitions; Risk Management; Sustainable and Impact Investing |
| Leadership / Operation Track | Business Value of Digital Disruptions - CXO Perspectives; Service and Operations Analytics; Negotiating in Business; Supply Chain Strategy and Management; Risk Management in Global Supply Chains; Innovation in Digital Operations |
| Management / Strategy Track | Critical Thinking; Entrepreneurship and Business Planning; Global Economy - Issues and Challenges; Managing Innovation and Growth; Business Analytics for Decision Making; Design Thinking; Managing Teams; Online Business and Marketplaces |
| Marketing and Communications Track | Advance Marketing Strategy; Applied Marketing Research and Analytics; Consumer Behaviour; Digital Marketing Strategy; Pricing; Storytelling for Brands and Leaders |
The SMU MBA comes with optional specialisations in Communications, Entrepreneurship, Finance, or Human Capital. **10 electives are required** to complement **8 core modules**. With a wide range of electives available, including those on offer by partner universities, participants are encouraged to choose from a number of electives based on their interests and knowledge gaps.
The Part-Time programme is designed for working professionals over a span of **20 months**. Core classes (Terms 1 to 4) take place on either Saturday morning and afternoon (January Intake), or Monday and Tuesday evenings (August Intake). Elective classes (Terms 5 to 7) take place from Monday to Thursday (**7pm to 10.45pm**) and Saturday.
The Full-Time programme spreads over **15 months** with a **compulsory internship**. Core classes (Terms 1 and 2) take place from Monday to Thursday, either in the morning or afternoon. Elective classes (Terms 3 to 5) take place from Monday to Thursday (**7pm to 10.45 pm**) and Saturday. The duration of each class is **3 hours 45 minutes**. The Full-Time schedule includes a **minimum 10-week, compulsory paid internship**.
The programme is not taught via e-learning: both Part-time and Full-time MBA require physical attendance. Some modules use web and online updates to supplement time in class.

Financial Aid.content:
- Partial scholarships for the Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme entail award amounts up to S$21,000 of the tuition fee, with no bonds attached. The prevailing GST will still apply for the full tuition fee before the scholarship award.
- All candidates are automatically submitted for consideration for the SMU-ASEAN, Academic Excellence and Global Awareness Scholarships upon meeting scholarship criteria.
- Scholarships listed: Academic Excellence, Global Awareness, Leadership Potential, Community Impact, Impact on Asia, Women in Business, SMU-ASEAN. Leadership, Community Impact, Impact on Asia, and Women in Business are scholarships that students can apply for upon admissions into the MBA programme.
- Academic Excellence Award: based on academic merit, final grades and GMAT score (700 and above).
- SMU-ASEAN Scholarship: no application required; award amount is S$10,000 with no bonds attached. Eligibility: successful admission into the SMU Full-time or Part-time MBA Programme; open to nationals of ASEAN member countries except Singaporeans.
- Lee Kuan Yew Scholarships: in addition to the one-off sum of S$10,000, private sector awardees receive an annual allowance of S$50,000, while public sector awardees receive S$10,000 if concurrently sponsored by their organisations. Eligibility includes Singapore citizenship, at least a Second Upper Honours Degree or equivalent, and excellent leadership/service record.
- APEC Scholarship: bond-free scholarship awarded annually to deserving Full-time SMU MBA candidates from APEC member economies excluding Singaporeans. Package includes monthly stipend of S$1,350, book allowance of S$500, tuition fee, health insurance, examination fee and other approved fees/allowances/expenses, one overseas Business Study Mission, travel from home country to Singapore, and travel from Singapore to home country upon successful completion. Eligibility includes citizen of an APEC member economy, good academic results, at least two years of management or professional experience, English proficiency, good GMAT score, and no prior study abroad.
- SkillsFuture: SkillsFuture Funding for Singapore Citizens. The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme provides Singapore Citizens aged 40 years and above the opportunity to receive the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top up of $4,000 to offset out-of-pocket tuition fees, starting from Academic Year 2024/25 intake, commencing on or after 1 May 2024.
- Tuition discounts: SMU alumni are automatically eligible for an alumni discount when applying to the MBA programme. Graduates from NUS, NTU, SUSS, SUTD, or SIT are automatically eligible for an alumni discount of S$4,000. Singaporean citizens and Permanent Residents are eligible for a one-time discount of S$5,000. ASEAN citizens are eligible for a one-time discount of S$3,000. Eligible company-sponsored candidates are eligible for a one-time Corporate Partner Award discount of S$7,500. These discounts apply to students joining from the January 2025 intake onwards; each student is only eligible for one discount, and only the higher discount applies if more than one is available.
- FAQ: The SMU MBA Programme offers a number of scholarships for both Full-time and Part-time students. Students can apply for scholarships upon admission to the Programme. Award amounts up to 30% of tuition fees. There are no bonds attached to the scholarships. There are no financial aid schemes available for the MBA programme.

Multiple Applications.content: If you have applied for more than one programme, you are only required to take the test once. Please contact your first-choice’s programme office to register for the test and update the other programme office upon the completion of your test via email to ensure timely processing of all your SMU applications.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: Students who did not complete the pre-course before the start of the term will be deferred to the next intake.
